name: D-LAKE ACY01
notes: Edge data center listed in Annecy/Haute-Savoie at 1 esplanade Augustin Aussedat; Data Center Map reports 0.05 MW.

name: Alpes Networks Data Center
notes: Annecy-area data center at 17 Rue Mira / Chavanod; local business directory states Alpes Networks owns a fiber network and datacenter in Annecy/Haute-Savoie.

name: Haute-Saône Numérique territorial data center option
notes: Public concession notice includes an optional tranche for construction of a data center on Haute-Saône territory; no capacity disclosed.

name: UltraEdge Limoges TDR
notes: Official UltraEdge page lists the Limoges TDR proximity datacenter in Nouvelle-Aquitaine, postal code 87280.

name: UltraEdge Limoges Dion Bouton
notes: Official UltraEdge page lists the Limoges Dion Bouton proximity datacenter in Nouvelle-Aquitaine.

name: ASP Limoges data centers
developer: Agence de Services et de Paiement / French agriculture ministry procurement
notes: Tender listing references cleaning services for ASP data centers located in Limoges; exact facility names and capacities not disclosed.

name: SoberCloud Briançon solar datacenter
notes: Company site describes a French sovereign cloud running from a solar Alpine datacenter in Briançon; business registration lists operation of data centers as an activity.

name: Alp'Cloud local datacenter project
notes: Trade/local press reports a Gap-based project to equip the southern Alps with a local datacenter; no capacity disclosed.

name: Ollink Hautes-Pyrénées datacenter
notes: Operator site announces opening of its datacenter in Hautes-Pyrénées for server hosting and data backup.

name: UltraEdge Tarbes Est
notes: Official UltraEdge pages list Tarbes Est, postal code 65600, as an Occitanie proximity datacenter.

name: Prosoluce Lannemezan datacenter project
notes: Local press reports Prosoluce network expansion in Lannemezan with a datacenter project; no capacity disclosed.

name: Digital Realty Paris PAR4
notes: Official Digital Realty page lists PAR4 at 21 Rue du Port, Parc de l'Ile-Allee Bleue, Nanterre 92000; Paris overview reports about 1,260 sq m for PAR4.

name: UltraEdge Courbevoie 5
notes: Official UltraEdge page lists Courbevoie 5, postal code 92400, as an Ile-de-France datacenter.

name: Global Switch Paris campus
notes: Official Global Switch page places the Paris campus at Clichy-Levallois near La Défense; French company registry shows Global Switch Paris at 7 rue Petit, 92110 Clichy with data-processing/hosting activity.

name: Lumen Paris Le Capitole
notes: Lumen colocation datasheet describes a modern data centre in the Nanterre district with 4 MVA maximum site power; Baxtel lists the facility as Paris Le Capitole in Nanterre.

name: ETIX Montpellier #1 / MPL1
notes: Operator page describes ETIX Montpellier as a secure, scalable data center serving Occitanie and PACA; DC Hub reports 3 MW and operational status.

name: France Travail DGA Tech Castelnau-le-Lez data center
notes: Public procurement notice covers server-storage expansion for France Travail data centers including Castelnau-le-Lez (34); architect page says the Castelnau-le-Lez data center/warehouse project was delivered in 2023 with 3,500 sq m surface.

name: Kyndryl Montpellier-Grabels
notes: Industry databases list Kyndryl Montpellier/Grabels data center near Montpellier with reported 0.521 MW capacity; operator page not found in public search.

name: TDF ProxiCenter Rennes-Cesson
notes: Official TDF page says the Rennes-Cesson datacenter was commissioned in July 2014, with nine rooms and 140 bays; Data Center Map reports 0.6 MW.

name: Nation Data Center Rennes 2
notes: NDC acquired the former Groupama Mordelles facility and rebranded it Rennes 2; reports cite 720 kW installed IT capacity with expansion potential to 1.36 MW.

name: UltraEdge Rennes
notes: Industry marketplaces list UltraEdge Rennes in Cesson-Sévigné as operational; DC Hub reports 3 MW, Datalok reports 1.4 MW IT power with 1.25 MW available.

name: Blue Rennes
notes: DCmag map lists Blue Rennes in Ille-et-Vilaine with 2,000 sq m IT surface and 3,000 kW electric IT power.

name: Google Ozans-Châteauroux data center campus
developer: Google / Tricolore Computing / Violet Computing / RTE
notes: CNDP project page says the Ozans-Châteauroux project spans about 195 ha and would include 8 to 10 data-center buildings plus grid connection infrastructure. Capacity is reported by press as up to 500 MW, not confirmed in the CNDP summary.
